meta.title: PCF (Piping Component File, Alias / Intergraph / Hexagon ISOGEN) keywords and syntax rules used by the 05 ISO MVP
meta.note: Transcribed facts only; the PCF Reference Guide itself (Alias Ltd, version 2016 13.0, ~388 pages) was not reachable from the authoring sandbox. Each row names its source id from ../sources.md. Grade per row: A = two or more independent sources agree; B = one secondary extract; C = located, not confirmed. Only A rows may gate a pass / fail test; B rows define llull's MVP subset and are re-checked against the guide before V1 (open question OQ-ISO-01).

syntaxRules.rule: First line of the file is ISOGEN-FILES <file>
Header units: UNITS-BORE (MM | INCH), UNITS-CO-ORDS (MM | INCH), UNITS-WEIGHT (KGS | LBS), UNITS-BOLT-DIA, UNITS-BOLT-LENGTH, UNITS-WEIGHT-LENGTH (METER | FEET)
A component starts with its type keyword at column 1; its attributes are on the following indented lines
Item code and description entries under a material identifier start in column 5 (4-space indent)
No TAB characters anywhere in the file
END-POINT x y z bore [endType]: coordinates in UNITS-CO-ORDS, nominal bore in UNITS-BORE, optional two-character end-connection code
CENTRE-POINT x y z: coordinates only (elbows, bends, tees)
Elbow / bend: two END-POINT records and one CENTRE-POINT record
Tee: two END-POINT records, CENTRE-POINT and BRANCH1-POINT (with bore)
SKEY <4 chars>: ISOGEN symbol key, mandatory for every component except PIPE
ITEM-CODE <code> on a component links it to the MATERIALS section; MATERIALS lists ITEM-CODE then an indented DESCRIPTION line; it is placed at the end of the file
SUPPORT components use CO-ORDS x y z (not END-POINT)
Field-fit welds are written as erection items (ERECTION-ITEM); ERECTION / OFFSHORE category items mark the end of a spool in ISOGEN spool splitting
SPOOL-IDENTIFIER CO-ORDS x y z TEXT t: user-positioned spool label
HIGHEST-WELD-NUMBER N (pipeline header): new welds are numbered N+1, N+2, ... (repeatability)
One PCF per pipeline (line number) on export

mvp.skey: WW shop / WS site / WF field-fit

endConnectionCodes.note: Two-character codes; the same letters form the last two characters of many SKEYs (ELBW = elbow butt weld).

caesarIIAttributeMap.note: CAESAR II PCF import reads COMPONENT-ATTRIBUTE1..10 as: 1 design pressure, 2 max temperature, 3 material name, 4 wall thickness, 5 insulation thickness, 6 insulation density, 7 corrosion allowance, 8 component weight, 9 fluid density, 10 hydro test pressure. Relevant to sibling 07-pipe-stress-flexibility.
